resources.string: Keep personal preferences the same on every TV signed in to this Jellyfin account. Each TV keeps its own layout. Off by default.
Last sync failed; it will retry automatically
Settings could not be synced. Check the connection to your Jellyfin server; your settings on this TV are unchanged.
The account changed before sync finished. Nothing was changed.
Deletes this account\'s synced settings from the Jellyfin server and turns sync off here. Settings on each TV stay as they are.
Remove the synced settings for this account from the Jellyfin server? Other TVs keep their current settings but stop receiving changes until sync is turned on again.

Synced: spoiler controls, hide-watched filters, watched indicator, rating badges, series thumbnails, remote long-press action, autoplay, cinema prerolls, skip lengths, and subtitle brightness, weight and colors.

Kept per TV: Home rows and item limits, card size, theme, backdrop, clock, Reduced Motion, and subtitle size and position.

Never synced: sign-in details, server addresses, device and playback compatibility options, watch history, Watch Later, shortcuts and remembered track choices. The synced copy is stored with your Jellyfin user and is only visible to that user and server administrators.
This account already has synced settings that differ from this TV:
These settings were changed on this TV and on another device. Other changes were synced automatically.
